gloss: to make fun of; to look down on; to belittle

definitions.gloss: to make fun of; to look down on; to belittle
definitions.explanation: To treat someone as slightly stupid or inferior, often with a condescending attitude. Implies a mild but insulting degree of mockery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{小馬鹿|こばか}にするな。
{小馬鹿|こばか}にしたような⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{小馬鹿|こばか}にした⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That boss always speaks to subordinates in a belittling way.

examples.japanese: {小馬鹿|こばか}にされて、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{悔|くや}しかった→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧。
examples.english: I was made fun of and felt very frustrated.

notes:
Expresses a mild but clear form of mockery or condescension. The ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ prefix softens ⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧ (fool/stupid), but paradoxically this makes the expression more cutting — it implies the speaker considers the target not worth taking seriously.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {小馬鹿|こばか}にする: to belittle, make fun of
- {小馬鹿|こばか}にされる: to be made fun of (passive)
- {小馬鹿|こばか}にしたような⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧: a mocking laugh
- {小馬鹿|こばか}にしたような⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: a condescending attitude
- {小馬鹿|こばか}にした⟦{口調|くちょう}→口調：11803_kuchou⟧: a sneering tone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a fool of — stronger and more directly insulting
- ⟦{見下|みくだ}す→見下す：09911_mikudasu⟧: to look down on — more about perceived superiority
- ⟦{嘲笑|ちょうしょう}→嘲笑：09026_choushou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to ridicule — more formal/literary

FORMS:
⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ (small, slight) + ⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧ (fool) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to treat as). The ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ prefix creates a sense of dismissive, casual contempt.
